entities.summary: Duncan Upshaw Fletcher was an American lawyer and politician of the Democratic Party who served in the U.S. Senate and as mayor of Jacksonville, Florida. Fletcher was the longest-serving U.S. Senator in Florida's history. He served two terms as Mayor of Jacksonville and served in the Florida House of Representatives.
